# M0-a-14 — independent check (lane `check/M0-a-14`, flow flow-7, stage group 9)

**Verdict: FAIL.** There are five blocker lines, B1 – B5. All five are the same kind of defect: a design clause, or a
C-0200 reading, that the item states and builds has no negative control, so a targeted mutant on it passes every test
the item lists. The code is correct on every input the checker tried. Every gate the item's files touch passes. The fix
round needs only new negative fixtures (templates below) and changes no source file. Ten minor notes for M4 are in
`checks/M0-a-14-notes.md`.

Checker: Opus 5.5, Claude Code on the owner's WSL2 PC (Linux x64, Node v24.12.0), 2026-10-05. Not the item's author.
The checker did not read the author's self-check before planning its own mutants and probes.

## 4 Checklist

* **Interfaces — pass (CONFIRMED).** The kernel exports `checkBatch(record, plat, ctx?)`, `checkStageEnd(plat, ctx?)`,
  `checkSave`, `checkCI`, `debugAssertSlot(p, stamp, slot?)`, `KERNEL_ROWS`, `kernelExpect`, `expectRow`,
  `classFloorRow`, `kernelChecks` and `suiteEnv`, through `kernel/src/index.ts:18`. `Invariant` is
  `kernel/src/types/rows.ts:5`, and `@plat/model` re-exports it (`model/src/types/kernel.ts:41`).
* **Every §3.10 row mapped to a check by name — pass (CONFIRMED).**
  * `KERNEL_ROWS` has 21 entries for the design's 20 rows; the corner row is two entries, soft and hard (C-0200 (1)).
  * `fixtures.test.ts` "the rows" pins the list in the design's order. Every row has a describe block with a positive
    fixture and a hand-corrupted negative that names the row.
  * Rows whose subject M0 lacks (prepared-contacts M3a, frozen-base M1, pool-scope M1, arena isolation across parts
    M3a / M6-U, seed-tiling M6-P) hold vacuously with subjects 0 and a note naming the milestone. Their predicates are
    judged directly.
* **Soft rows go to the report, never into expect — pass (CONFIRMED).** `expectRow` and the transaction both refuse a
  soft entry, and a soft violation commits while the report carries it (`expect.test.ts`). Mutants K39, K40 and K45 are
  killed.
* **Listed tests:**
  * (1) Each row has a positive fixture and a negative control: present, but **five rows have a clause the negatives do
    not pin (B1 – B5)**.
  * (2) The §13.2 cost model: faces read ≤ 12 × max(1, touched) on 12 fuzz runs, with more than 100 lines checked, and
    a growth control. The growth control gives the same {faces, vertices, edges} counts at k = 4, 8, 12, 16 blocks.
    Mutants K43 (the touched set made whole-arena) and K44 (clearance reads a 100 000 cm box) are killed. **Pass.**
  * (3) The debug assertion fires on a stale stamp and on a foreign arena's stamp (K42 killed), and the flag is off in
    a `define`d bundle (K41 killed). **Pass.** See note 7 on tree-shaking.
  * (4) The Euler characteristic is checked per level on every B-FUZZ arena: `checkCI` runs after every fuzz step, and
    the test asserts that euler has subjects > 0. **Pass.** The row's negative control has a hole (B2).
* **Exit bar "every §3.10 row implemented at its scope with its positive and negative fixtures; batch validation
  O(touched) on the fuzz runs".** The O(touched) half passes. The fixtures half is held back by B1 – B5.
* **No undeclared shortcut — pass (CONFIRMED).** There is no `TODO`, skip, `.only` or `notBuilt` in the 13 files

* **No undeclared deviation — pass.** C-0200 states each reading (subjects, context, simple-faces, nesting, the flag,
  the cost bar) and the tests that hold it.
* **Math / paths / evidence — pass (CONFIRMED).**
  * The lint is green. The only `Math` members used are abs, min and max. `Math.PI` is avoided: line 48 of `batch.ts`
    mentions it only in a comment.
  * Every import stays inside `plat/`.
  * The debug test writes its bundle to `os.tmpdir()`, which is output and not input. Kernel and testkit tests already do

* **Clean room — pass.** L-0166 lists only `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` sections, `plat/` files and esbuild's public docs.
* **No contended timing presented — pass.** The tests take no timing.

## 5 Probes (CONFIRMED, run in the scratch mirror `~/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-a-14/`)

* **A — placement bound with `placed` handed in.** 16 fuzz seeds, 195 commits. Each batch's new vertices were passed in
  as `placed`. Result: 141 subjects, 0 problems from any hard row.
* **B — nudged vertices.** 300 trials, each moving a vertex by up to ±30 or ±400 cm and re-attaching the index. The
  independent oracles (`allProblems`) broke 17 arenas. The suite missed 0 of them, both batch-local (a record naming the
  vertex as moved, with its faces) and in `checkCI`.
* **C — nested islands.** An L2 ring with an L3 ring inside it, plus a second L3 island: nesting, Euler and the whole
  suite hold, and so do the oracles.
* **Bundle.** `define PLAT_DEBUG_BUILD=false` against `dist/` switches the arena off. Under `plat-source` with
  `sideEffects: false`, `debug.ts` is tree-shaken and the switch stays on. This is note 7, for M1's app bundle.

* **33 killed** by the item's own tests: K01, K04 – K07, K11, K12, K14, K15, K17 – K22, K24 – K30, K34 – K37,
  K39 – K45.
* **Equivalent:** K02 (624 is not a sum of two squares) and K16 (a run's ends are its nearest vertices of its level).
* **Same verdict on honest input (note 1, note 2):** K03 (clearance's second loop), and K08 / K09 (simple-faces'
  duplicate pair and overlap). The checker's controls C1 and C2 still fail the row through another clause.
* **Off-promise survivor (note 3):** K13 (an L0 face names no parent).
* **Survivors on stated promises.** The item's tests do not kill these; the checker's controls do: K02b, K38, K31, K32,
  K33, K10 and K23. These are the blockers.

## 7 Blockers

* **B1 — min-edge.** The negatives use axis-aligned edges only, at 24 and 25 cm. Mutant K02b measures length with the
  L1 norm (`|dx| + |dy| < r`) and survives the whole test set.
  * Control C5: the lane (500, 500)–(1500, 1500) with its end moved to (517, 517), a 24.04 cm diagonal. The row fails on
    the real code and holds under K02b.
  * Required: add a diagonal negative (24.04 cm fails) and a diagonal positive at the bound (for example (0, 0)–(15, 20),
    25 cm, holds).
* **B2 — euler.** The only negative is a rotation swap, which makes V − E + F too small by 2. Mutant K38 flags only
  χ < components (`χ ≠ 1 + c` replaced by `χ < c`) and survives.
  * Control C4: re-link the lower-left L1 block's ring into two cycles by swapping the successors of the half-edges
    entering (0, 0) and (2000, 2000). That gives one face too many, `checkCI` fails euler, and K38 holds.
  * Required: add a negative for a face count that is too high, plus one for a deficit of exactly 1, so that equality
    is pinned in both directions.
* **B3 — references-resolve.** Three §3.10 clauses have no negative.
  * (a) "at least one knot per ring". K31 survives. Control C6: a closed `kerb` ring with a `width_knot` profile of 0
    values.
  * (b) "every indexed role … finds exactly one vertex": a role row on a dead slot. K32 survives. Control C7:
    `addRole(deck_end)` on the vertex (2000, 2000), then `flags |= VERTEX_FREE`.
  * (c) "no geometry carries a dead entity" through a face owner. The existing negative only kills a role row's entity.
    K33 survives. Control C8: `setOwner` of an L1 face to `block:dead`, with `isLive` false for it.
  * Required: add the three negatives.
* **B4 — simple-faces, C-0200 (4)'s "each hole ring clockwise or flat".** Neither the winding fixtures nor the fuzz runs
  ever see a hole ring wound counter-clockwise. K10 survives.
  * Control C3: an L2 island ring, with the host face's hole half-edges replaced by their twins
    (`setFaceHoles(…, holes.map(h => h ^ 1))`). The row fails, and holds under K10.
  * Required: add that negative.
* **B5 — prepared-contacts, "shared no finer edge".** C-0200 (13) says vacuous rows keep their predicates "built and
  tested", and §3.10 states this clause. K23 survives.
  * Control C9: an L1 way edge carrying an L2 `kerb` row, with `prepared: []`.
  * Required: add that negative.

A copy of the checker's control code is kept, for reference only, at
`~/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-a-14/zz2-checker-controls.test.ts.keep` (scratch, outside `plat/`, never an input). The
recipes above are complete without it. The fix round re-runs the item's five test files and the kernel gate.
